description: Ministry of Health & Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Notify the National Policy & Strategic framework on Injury Prevention & Management in Sri Lanka
reasoning: The gazette content announces the approval and implementation of the "National Policy and Strategic Framework on Injury Prevention and Management in Sri Lanka." This constitutes a regulatory framework and policy document that establishes guidelines and strategic directions for injury prevention, falling under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) as it creates a new policy framework rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
